findings.title: Parent selection explains several apparent deletion gains
findings.detail: A32 DETR/Deformable-DETR and cloud-origin hallucination improvements, reversed toddler-feeding recovery and Simula/Enkidu required-bridge anchors already occur in the parent before pruning. Specificity chain 0341 already hits with a false ceil(45/2)=75 assertion. These cases do not establish pruning-created content.

findings.title: Deletion can remove a flagged claim without recovering useful facts
findings.detail: .005 chemistry deletes the parent benzoic-acid and constant-solubility bullets; the official consistent result has zero true claims and does not state nitrite solubility. DailyDialog .005 removes the flagged child/millions-of-interactions fragments. Official class changes and informativeness remain separate.

findings.title: Arithmetic gains often expose existing numbers
findings.detail: Parent-relative chain gains at 0244, 0352, 0377, 0095 and 0082 isolate already-present intermediates or alter extraction priority; random deletion also produces gains. Wrong starts or false equations remain in several hit examples. No new numeral or valid derivation is inferred.

findings.title: Some losses retain the relevant information
findings.detail: N1 chain 0737 keeps 27, 0271 keeps (20+2)/2=11 and coefficient 0240 keeps floor(15/2)=7, yet official extraction priority changes to a nonhit. Hall sleep/personal-life regression flags an unchanged retained fragment. Official scores remain intact; retained-context sensitivity is a reviewer observation.

findings.title: Other losses visibly delete the accepted source
findings.detail: N1 chain 0200/0256 delete 6/7 bullets. Multi-hop N1 removes Tugela Falls or Coyolxauhqui while optional target names remain. A32 random comedian deletion drops the scathing-comeback cue, although calm silencing survives and other question sites still pass.

findings.title: A selected capped-N1 witness may not be a parent witness
findings.detail: Several A32 regressions show an already-nonpassing selected parent cell. The source pack correctly retains whole-question counts and a different first parent passing site; content at the selected site alone does not explain the whole-grid loss.
